e.title: Landslide Susceptibility (SCAR-on)
e.summary: CNN+ML 滑坡敏感性制图工具（101★）：数据构建/训练/评估/制图一体化，SPP 多尺度输入
e.body:
Landslide-susceptibility-mapping（scar-on，101★）是滑坡敏感性制图（LSM）工具：面向地质灾害工作者快速生成滑坡敏感性图——实现数据构建、模型训练、评估与制图全流程；全连接层前的改进空间金字塔池化（SPP）层支持不同尺寸输入，无需按窗口重设计网络。对 RIAA：滑坡灾害的 ML 制图——财产险/巨灾的滑坡风险（山坡地带）灾害图层；与 [[hazimp]]（影响评估）、[[physrisk]]（物理气候风险）、[[ml-flood]]（ECMWF 洪水 ML）配套构成灾害 ML 制图工具集。

## 同类工具
[[natcat-tc-modelling]]、[[uclfitter]]、[[wildfire-forecasting]]、[[alpaca-oasis-runner]]、[[apac-catastrophe-monitor]]

e.summary_hk: CNN+ML 滑坡敏感性製圖工具（101★）：數據構建/訓練/評估/製圖一體化，SPP 多尺度輸入
e.body_en:
Landslide-susceptibility-mapping (scar-on, 101★) is a landslide-susceptibility mapping (LSM) tool: it rapidly generates landslide-susceptibility maps for geohazard practitioners — data construction, model training, evaluation and map generation in one pipeline; an improved Spatial Pyramid Pooling (SPP) layer before the fully connected layer accepts inputs of different sizes without network redesign. For RIAA: ML mapping of the landslide hazard — a hazard layer for property/catastrophe landslide risk (hillside regions); with [[hazimp]] (impact assessment), [[physrisk]] (physical climate risk) and [[ml-flood]] (ECMWF flood ML) it forms the hazard-ML mapping toolkit.

## Similar tools
[[natcat-tc-modelling]]、[[uclfitter]]、[[wildfire-forecasting]]、[[alpaca-oasis-runner]]、[[apac-catastrophe-monitor]]
